About Booking Holdings Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world’s leading provider of online travel and related services, provided to consumers and local partners in more than 220 countries and territories through five primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. For more information, visit BookingHoldings.com and follow us on X BookingHoldings. About Booking Holdings Romania: Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania, opened in September 2021. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leveraging industry best practices, and fostering collaboration opportunities across Booking Holdings’ brands and business units. Booking Holdings Romania is supporting Booking Holdings and its portfolio of brands by providing capabilities in many important areas like Security & Fraud, Application Development, Data Analytics, Data Governance, IT End-User Support, Global Business Services, Marketing, Procurement, Legal & Compliance, Privacy, as well as Program Management Office, with new competences in other areas being added throughout the coming years.
Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania and was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of our Brands.As part of our Booking Holdings Romania team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of the worlds leading provider of online travel, with a mission of making it easier for everyone to experience the world through six-primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, OpenTable and Rentalcars.com.Role description The Senior Security Engineer - serves as a technical lead and subject matter expert for the Threat Exposure Management (TEM) capability: designs, builds and operates the technical foundation across four areas: Threat Detection & Engineering, Security Tooling & Architecture, Threat Intelligence Integration, and Automation & Orchestration. The role exists to turn external threat information into timely, evidence-backed answers on whether Booking Holdings brands are exposed, and to route each relevant exposure to the accountable team, with visibility over the actions taken through to verified closure. Success means a scalable, auditable and federated capability, adopted by the brands, that measurably reduces the time needed to determine and remediate exposure. This role provides a hybrid way of working with an onsite presence of 2 days/week.Key Job Responsibilities and DutiesThreat Detection & EngineeringDesigns, builds and maintains exposure detection logic and threat hunting queries in line with the TEM data contract, to determine quickly and defensibly whether emerging threats affect Booking Holdings brands.Owns the operational health of the TEM pipeline and automations, including reliability and performance improvements.Translates threat intelligence and potential threats into detection use cases, validating and tuning them with brand detection and response teams to reduce false positives and evidence gaps.Security Tooling & ArchitectureDesigns and evolves the TEM technical architecture (threat intelligence aggregation, asset and
